subject.title: [Feature]: Interactive goal pill in Control UI chat with edit/pause/clear controls and elapsed time

question: Should OpenClaw add an in-place `/goal edit <objective>` command and interactive Control UI goal pill in core now?
rationale: The request is aligned with web/CLI ergonomics, but it changes goal command semantics and built-in Control UI behavior, and the protected `maintainer` label requires an explicit product direction before automation should implement it.

options.title: Sponsor focused core implementation
options.body: Implement `/goal edit` with accounting-preserving semantics and add the compact Control UI pill controls against the existing command path.

options.title: Split backend command first
options.body: Add and prove `/goal edit` plus TUI/docs support first, then take the richer Control UI pill as a follow-up design PR.

options.title: Defer interactive goal UI
options.body: Keep the current passive chip and typed commands until a broader Control UI command-action model is chosen.

recommendation.title: Sponsor focused core implementation
recommendation.body: Implement `/goal edit` with accounting-preserving semantics and add the compact Control UI pill controls against the existing command path.

likelyOwner.reason: @steipete opened this feature and is also the visible current-main history owner for the goal UI and command surfaces inspected here.
